snippet.title: DITTORI - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the demo and wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4311980/DITTORI/

In an ancient temple deep beneath the world, a primordial god with the power to manipulate space awakens, and threatens to bring about the end of all things. To sate the god, you have been offered as a sacrifice from the surface, and must master DITTORI, the god’s forbidden power. You've been bestowed the power to split objects to be in two places at once.
